title: Length of joined fields
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be a type and let $fs$ be a nonempty finite list of finite lists of elements of $\Gamma$. Join the fields by inserting one separator between consecutive fields, and let the offset after all fields be the sum, over each field, of its length plus one. Then the length of the joined list plus one equals that offset.
hypotheses_covered: $fs$ is a finite list of finite lists of elements of $\Gamma$
